D3 additionally counts phase_status_changed as drift after finding 70 such events already appended repo-wide in a week, every one invisible to freshness. Dogfooded against the live record through a stdio server built from the tree: Phases 1 and 2 closed, Phase 3 dropped with its reason, a drop with no reason refused, a re-issue appending nothing, and a mistyped name refused while naming the five real phases. Also ruled D4 (add_task out of scope; rare but working, three uses ever) and D5 (repair the 35, append-only, never a shipped command). Left for a record-hygiene pass: peer residue in commit-attribution, drift-certification and the new hookspath-attribution record.
